verses.original: Δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Dikaiōthentes oun ek pisteōs eirēnēn echomen pros ton Theon dia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Therefore since we have been justified through faith we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Justificados, pois, pela fé, tenhamos paz com Deus por meio de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;

verses.original: δι’ οὗ καὶ τὴν προσαγωγὴν ἐσχήκαμεν τῇ πίστει εἰς τὴν χάριν ταύτην ἐν ᾗ ἑστήκαμεν καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: di’ hou kai tēn prosagōgēn eschēkamen tē pistei eis tēn charin tautēn en hē hestēkamen kai kauchōmetha ep’ elpidi tēs doxēs tou Theou
verses.literal: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we stand And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God
verses.literalPt: por quem igualmente temos obtido nossa entrada, pela fé, a esta graça na qual estamos firmes; e gloriemo-nos na esperança da glória de Deus.

verses.original: Οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν εἰδότες ὅτι ἡ θλῖψις ὑπομονὴν κατεργάζεται
verses.transliteration: Ou monon de alla kai kauchōmetha en tais thlipsesin eidotes hoti hē thlipsis hypomonēn katergazetai
verses.literal: Not only that but we also rejoice in our sufferings because we know that suffering produces perseverance
verses.literalPt: E não só isso, mas também nos gloriemos nas tribulações, sabendo que a tribulação produz fortaleza;

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ὑπομονὴ δοκιμήν ἡ δὲ δοκιμὴ ἐλπίδα
verses.transliteration: hē de hypomonē dokimēn hē de dokimē elpida
verses.literal: perseverance character and character hope
verses.literalPt: e a fortaleza, experiência;

verses.original: ἡ δὲ ἐλπὶς οὐ καταισχύνει ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου τοῦ δοθέντος ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: hē de elpis ou kataischynei hoti hē agapē tou Theou ekkechytai en tais kardiais hēmōn dia Pneumatos Hagiou tou dothentos hēmin
verses.literal: And hope does not disappoint us because God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit whom He has given us
verses.literalPt: e a experiência, esperança; e a esperança não envergonha, porque o amor de Deus tem sido derramado em nossos corações pelo Espírito Santo, que nos foi dado.

verses.original: Ἔτι γὰρ Χριστὸς ὄντων ἡμῶν ἀσθενῶν ἔτι κατὰ καιρὸν ὑπὲρ ἀσεβῶν ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: Eti gar Christos ontōn hēmōn asthenōn eti kata kairon hyper asebōn apethanen
verses.literal: For at just the right time while we were still powerless Christ died for the ungodly
verses.literalPt: Quando nós ainda éramos fracos, Cristo morreu a seu tempo pelos ímpios.

verses.original: μόλις γὰρ ὑπὲρ δικαίου τις ἀποθανεῖται ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ τάχα τις καὶ τολμᾷ ἀποθανεῖν
verses.transliteration: molis gar hyper dikaiou tis apothaneitai hyper gar tou agathou tacha tis kai tolma apothanein
verses.literal: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man though for a good man someone might possibly . . . dare to die
verses.literalPt: Apenas morrerá alguém por um justo; pois pelo bom é possível que alguém até se atreva a morrer;

verses.original: συνίστησιν δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀγάπην εἰς ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ὅτι ἔτι ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄντων ἡμῶν Χριστὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: synistēsin de tēn heautou agapēn eis hēmas ho Theos hoti eti hamartōlōn ontōn hēmōn Christos hyper hēmōn apethanen
verses.literal: But God proves His love for us in this While we were still sinners Christ died for us
verses.literalPt: mas Deus prova o seu amor para conosco em que, quando éramos ainda pecadores, morreu Cristo por nós.

verses.original: Πολλῷ οὖν μᾶλλον δικαιωθέντες νῦν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ σωθησόμεθα δι’ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς
verses.transliteration: Pollō oun mallon dikaiōthentes nyn en tō haimati autou sōthēsometha di’ autou apo tēs orgēs
verses.literal: Therefore since we have now been justified . . . by His blood how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him
verses.literalPt: Ora, muito mais, sendo agora justificados pelo seu sangue, seremos por ele salvos da ira.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ ἐχθροὶ ὄντες κατηλλάγημεν τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ πολλῷ μᾶλλον καταλλαγέντες σωθησόμεθα ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei gar echthroi ontes katēllagēmen tō Theō dia tou thanatou tou Huiou autou pollō mallon katallagentes sōthēsometha en tē zōē autou
verses.literal: For if when we were enemies of God we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son how much more having been reconciled shall we be saved through His life
verses.literalPt: Se, quando éramos inimigos, fomos reconciliados com Deus pela morte de seu Filho, muito mais, tendo sido reconciliados, seremos salvos pela sua vida;

verses.original: οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ οὗ νῦν τὴν καταλλαγὴν ἐλάβομεν
verses.transliteration: ou monon de alla kai kauchōmenoi en tō Theō dia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou di’ hou nyn tēn katallagēn elabomen
verses.literal: Not only that but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ through whom we have now received reconciliation
verses.literalPt: e não só isso, mas também nos gloriamos em Deus por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, por quem agora temos recebido reconciliação.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ὥσπερ δι’ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἡ ἁμαρτία εἰς τὸν κόσμον εἰσῆλθεν καὶ διὰ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ θάνατος καὶ οὕτως εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους ὁ θάνατος διῆλθεν ἐφ’ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον
verses.transliteration: Dia touto hōsper di’ henos anthrōpou hē hamartia eis ton kosmon eisēlthen kai dia tēs hamartias ho thanatos kai houtōs eis pantas anthrōpous ho thanatos diēlthen eph’ hō pantes hēmarton
verses.literal: Therefore . . . just as sin entered . . . the world through one man and death through sin so also death was passed on to all men because . . . all sinned
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim como por um só homem entrou o pecado no mundo, e pelo pecado, a morte, assim também a morte passou a todos os homens, visto que todos pecaram;

verses.original: ἄχρι γὰρ νόμου ἁμαρτία ἦν ἐν κόσμῳ ἁμαρτία δὲ οὐκ ἐλλογεῖται μὴ ὄντος νόμου
verses.transliteration: achri gar nomou hamartia ēn en kosmō hamartia de ouk ellogeitai mē ontos nomou
verses.literal: For sin was in the world before the law was given but sin is not taken into account when there is no law
verses.literalPt: pois até a Lei o pecado estava no mundo, mas não é imputado o pecado quando não há lei.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θάνατος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ μέχρι Μωϋσέως καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μὴ ἁμαρτήσαντας ἐπὶ τῷ ὁμοιώματι τῆς παραβάσεως Ἀδάμ ὅς ἐστιν τύπος τοῦ μέλλοντος
verses.transliteration: alla ebasileusen ho thanatos apo Adam mechri Mōuseōs kai epi tous mē hamartēsantas epi tō homoiōmati tēs parabaseōs Adam hos estin typos tou mellontos
verses.literal: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses even over those who did not sin . . . in the way that Adam transgressed He is a pattern of the One to come
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, reinou a morte desde Adão até Moisés, ainda sobre aqueles que não pecaram à semelhança da transgressão de Adão, o qual é tipo daquele que havia de vir.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ οὐχ ὡς τὸ παράπτωμα οὕτως καὶ τὸ χάρισμα εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι οἱ πολλοὶ ἀπέθανον πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡ δωρεὰ ἐν χάριτι τῇ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς τοὺς πολλοὺς ἐπερίσσευσεν
verses.transliteration: All’ ouch hōs to paraptōma houtōs kai to charisma ei gar tō tou henos paraptōmati hoi polloi apethanon pollō mallon hē charis tou Theou kai hē dōrea en chariti tē tou henos anthrōpou Iēsou Christou eis tous pollous eperisseusen
verses.literal: But the gift - is not like the trespass For if the many died by the trespass of the one man how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man Jesus Christ abound to the many
verses.literalPt: Mas não é assim o dom como a ofensa; porque, se pela ofensa de um só morreram todos, muito mais a graça de Deus e o dom pela graça de um só homem, Jesus Cristo, abundou para com todos.

verses.original: καὶ οὐχ ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς ἁμαρτήσαντος τὸ δώρημα τὸ μὲν γὰρ κρίμα ἐξ ἑνὸς εἰς κατάκριμα τὸ δὲ χάρισμα ἐκ πολλῶν παραπτωμάτων εἰς δικαίωμα
verses.transliteration: kai ouch hōs di’ henos hamartēsantos to dōrēma to men gar krima ex henos eis katakrima to de charisma ek pollōn paraptōmatōn eis dikaiōma
verses.literal: Again the gift is not like the result of the one man’s sin - The judgment that followed one sin brought condemnation but the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification
verses.literalPt: A dádiva não é como por um só que pecou; porque o julgamento veio, na verdade, de uma só ofensa, para a condenação; mas o dom veio de muitas ofensas, para a justificação.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι ὁ θάνατος ἐβασίλευσεν διὰ τοῦ ἑνός πολλῷ μᾶλλον οἱ τὴν περισσείαν τῆς χάριτος καὶ τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς δικαιοσύνης λαμβάνοντες ἐν ζωῇ βασιλεύσουσιν διὰ τοῦ ἑνὸς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei gar tō tou henos paraptōmati ho thanatos ebasileusen dia tou henos pollō mallon hoi tēn perisseian tēs charitos kai tēs dōreas tēs dikaiosynēs lambanontes en zōē basileusousin dia tou henos Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: For if by the trespass of the one man death reigned through that one man how much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Se pela ofensa de um só reinou por ele a morte, muito mais os que recebem a abundância da graça e do dom da justiça reinarão em vida por um só, que é Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς παραπτώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς κατάκριμα οὕτως καὶ δι’ ἑνὸς δικαιώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς δικαίωσιν ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: Ara oun hōs di’ henos paraptōmatos eis pantas anthrōpous eis katakrima houtōs kai di’ henos dikaiōmatos eis pantas anthrōpous eis dikaiōsin zōēs
verses.literal: So then just as one trespass brought condemnation for all men so also one act of righteousness brought justification and life for all men
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, como por uma só ofensa veio o julgamento sobre todos os homens, para a condenação, assim também por um só ato de justiça veio o julgamento sobre todos os homens para a justificação da vida.

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ διὰ τῆς παρακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἁμαρτωλοὶ κατεστάθησαν οἱ πολλοί οὕτως καὶ διὰ τῆς ὑπακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς δίκαιοι κατασταθήσονται οἱ πολλοί
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar dia tēs parakoēs tou henos anthrōpou hamartōloi katestathēsan hoi polloi houtōs kai dia tēs hypakoēs tou henos dikaioi katastathēsontai hoi polloi
verses.literal: For just as . . . through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous
verses.literalPt: Assim como pela desobediência de um só homem foram todos constituídos pecadores, assim também pela obediência de um só todos serão constituídos justos.

verses.original: Νόμος δὲ παρεισῆλθεν ἵνα πλεονάσῃ τὸ παράπτωμα οὗ δὲ ἐπλεόνασεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ὑπερεπερίσσευσεν ἡ χάρις
verses.transliteration: Nomos de pareisēlthen hina pleonasē to paraptōma hou de epleonasen hē hamartia hypereperisseusen hē charis
verses.literal: The law came in so that the trespass would increase but where sin increased grace increased all the more
verses.literalPt: Sobreveio a Lei para que abundasse a ofensa; mas onde abundou o pecado, superabundou a graça,

verses.original: ἵνα ὥσπερ ἐβασίλευσεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ οὕτως καὶ ἡ χάρις βασιλεύσῃ διὰ δικαιοσύνης εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: hina hōsper ebasileusen hē hamartia en tō thanatō houtōs kai hē charis basileusē dia dikaiosynēs eis zōēn aiōnion dia Iēsou Christou tou Kyriou hēmōn
verses.literal: so that just as sin reigned in death so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord
verses.literalPt: para que, assim como reinou o pecado na morte, assim também reine a graça pela justiça para a vida eterna, mediante Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.
